set.body:
Milestone acceptance gate for PRD v0.2 M0: Contracts, provider admission, and frozen baselines.

This is an aggregation/review gate, not an implementation work packet. Required children: M0.01, M0.02, M0.03, M0.04, M0.05, M0.06, M0.07. Native blocks edges require their accepted completion. Child containment is non-blocking; do not add the gate as a prerequisite of its own children. See docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md for graph and IDs.

Exit: verify the relevant PRD milestone acceptance, exact source/provider and JVM/JS receipts, independent audit outcomes and permitted caveats. A filed ticket, accepted plan, unrun test, renamed legacy wrapper or historical candidate does not satisfy implementation. M1/M2 delete migrated routes; no retired ontology or private bridge may survive M3. M3 is an experimental foundation gate, not automatic scientific qualification. M4 requires scoped inferential calibration; M5 requires group and matched performance evidence. Do not close on partial delivery or publish a release automatically.

Owner role: milestone integrator with independent review. Start detailed work through ready leaf packets and narrow path claims; do not reserve the entire epic/module tree.
set.title: UMVPA-M0 GATE: Contracts, provider admission, and frozen baselines
